lieu: busy open-air fish market in Adjame, Abidjan, wooden stalls with fish on ice, colorful umbrellas, warm morning sunlight

persos.nom: the skinny young man in the red t-shirt
persos.desc: skinny young man in his 20s, short curly hair, red t-shirt, blue jeans, small backpack
persos.pose: leaning forward sniffing the fish suspiciously, one eyebrow raised

persos.nom: the fish seller in the green wax dress
persos.desc: large cheerful fish seller in her 50s, green-and-yellow wax dress with matching headwrap, gold hoop earrings
persos.pose: proudly holding up a big silver fish with both hands, confident grin

dialogue: Tantie, ton poisson-là, il est frais ?
Frais ? Ce matin même il m'a dit bonjour !
jeu: The young man sniffs the fish and asks suspiciously. The fish seller shakes the fish proudly as she answers.

lieu: public primary school classroom in Abobo, Abidjan, wooden double desks, green chalkboard, sunlight through open windows

persos.nom: the teacher in the beige shirt
persos.desc: tall thin male teacher in his 40s, round glasses, beige short-sleeve shirt, holding chalk
persos.pose: pointing at the pupil, patient smile

persos.nom: the little boy in the khaki uniform
persos.desc: small boy around 8, shaved head, khaki school uniform, big serious eyes
persos.pose: standing at his desk, very serious face

persos.nom: the little girl with pigtails
persos.desc: little girl around 8, two puffy pigtails with yellow bobbles, blue school uniform dress
persos.pose: sitting next to him, covering her mouth to hold back laughter

dialogue: Si ton papa te donne mille francs, tu as combien ?
Zéro, maître.
Faux !
Vous ne connaissez pas mon papa !
jeu: The teacher asks kindly, then corrects him firmly. The boy answers with total seriousness while the girl giggles.

lieu: modest living room in Yopougon, Abidjan, at night during a power cut, lit by a candle, patterned sofa, old TV

persos.nom: the boy in the orange football jersey
persos.desc: excited boy around 10, short hair, oversized orange football jersey
persos.pose: jumping and pointing at a ceiling bulb that just lit up

persos.nom: the father in the grey singlet
persos.desc: stocky father in his 40s, short beard, grey singlet, checkered pagne around his waist
persos.pose: rushing toward the boy, finger on his lips, eyes wide

persos.nom: the mother in the purple headwrap
persos.desc: mother in her 30s, purple wax dress and headwrap
persos.pose: sitting on the sofa holding a candle, puzzled

dialogue: Papa ! La lumière est revenue !
Chut ! Ne crie pas, ils vont entendre et la reprendre !
jeu: The boy shouts with joy. The father panics, whispers urgently and glances nervously at the bulb.

lieu: open-air maquis in Yopougon, Abidjan, plastic tables and chairs, string lights, smoke from the grill, evening

persos.nom: the man in the yellow polo
persos.desc: chubby man in his 30s, yellow polo shirt, small mustache, napkin tucked in his collar
persos.pose: pointing at his bowl of sauce in disgust

persos.nom: the waitress in the red apron
persos.desc: young waitress in her 20s, braided bun, red apron over a black t-shirt, notepad in hand
persos.pose: leaning in, finger on her lips, conspiratorial look

dialogue: Serveuse, une mouche dans ma sauce !
Chut ! Les autres vont tous vouloir la même !
jeu: The man complains loudly. The waitress hushes him and glances at the other tables.

lieu: sandy shared courtyard in Abobo, Abidjan, ochre walls, mango tree, laundry line, plastic chairs, afternoon sun

persos.nom: the teenage boy in the green hoodie
persos.desc: skinny teenage boy around 14, green hoodie, flip-flops, holding a broken old game controller
persos.pose: stomping his foot, whining

persos.nom: the father with the newspaper
persos.desc: relaxed father in his 50s, white kaftan, reading glasses on his nose, sitting on a plastic chair with a newspaper
persos.pose: lowering the newspaper calmly, deadpan stare

dialogue: Papa, tous mes amis ont une PlayStation !
Mes amis ont tous une voiture. Je pleure ?
jeu: The teenager whines and waves the broken controller. The father calmly lowers his newspaper and answers without emotion.

lieu: small doctor's office in a neighborhood clinic in Koumassi, Abidjan, white walls, health posters, wooden desk with a stethoscope

persos.nom: the doctor in the white coat
persos.desc: serious female doctor in her 40s, short natural hair, white coat, stethoscope around her neck
persos.pose: writing a prescription, wagging a finger

persos.nom: the thin man in the faded shirt
persos.desc: very thin man in his 50s, faded blue shirt far too big for him, patched trousers
persos.pose: sitting across the desk, shocked, hand on his chest

dialogue: Monsieur, il faut arrêter la viande.
Docteur, c'est la viande qui m'a arrêté !
jeu: The doctor gives her advice very seriously. The thin man raises both hands in despair as he answers.

lieu: inside an overcrowded green gbaka minibus in Abidjan traffic, passengers squeezed on wooden benches, open sliding door

persos.nom: the apprenti hanging at the door
persos.desc: wiry young bus apprentice in his 20s, red cap backwards, torn sleeveless jersey, coins in hand
persos.pose: hanging from the open door, waving more passengers in

persos.nom: the big man squeezed on the bench
persos.desc: very large man in his 40s, sweaty face, tight brown suit, briefcase on his lap
persos.pose: crushed between passengers, outraged

persos.nom: the old lady with the basket
persos.desc: old lady in her 70s, blue headwrap, big basket of tomatoes on her lap
persos.pose: squeezed against the window, rolling her eyes

dialogue: Serrez-vous ! Il reste une place !
Où ça ? Sur mes genoux ?!
Tonton, tes genoux sont libres, non ?
jeu: The apprentice shouts and points inside. The big man protests, then the apprentice points innocently at his knees.

lieu: cozy bedroom in a Marcory apartment, Abidjan, colorful bedspread, wall calendar with the 25th circled in red, lamp light

persos.nom: the wife in the pink nightdress
persos.desc: young wife in her late 20s, pink satin nightdress, hair in a silk bonnet
persos.pose: cuddling her husband's arm, batting her eyelashes

persos.nom: the husband with the empty wallet
persos.desc: husband in his 30s, white t-shirt, glasses, holding a completely empty open wallet
persos.pose: sweating nervously, glancing at the calendar

dialogue: Chéri, tu m'aimes combien ?
Bébé, pas de chiffres le 25 du mois !
jeu: The wife asks sweetly. The husband points nervously at the calendar and hides his empty wallet.

lieu: small tailor shop in Treichville, Abidjan, sewing machine, colorful wax fabric rolls on shelves, half-finished dresses on mannequins

persos.nom: the lady in the blue boubou
persos.desc: elegant lady in her 40s, blue embroidered boubou, matching headwrap, handbag
persos.pose: hands on hips, furious

persos.nom: the tailor with the tape measure
persos.desc: relaxed tailor in his 50s, tape measure around his neck, pencil behind his ear, green kaftan
persos.pose: calmly sewing, innocent smile

dialogue: Ma robe devait être prête depuis un mois !
La robe est prête. C'est le tissu qui manque.
jeu: The lady scolds the tailor. He keeps sewing calmly and answers with a reassuring smile.

lieu: shared rental courtyard in Abobo, Abidjan, row of blue doors, water tank, plastic buckets, late afternoon

persos.nom: the landlord in the brown suit
persos.desc: plump landlord in his 60s, brown three-piece suit, bowler hat, receipt book in hand
persos.pose: waving the receipt book angrily

persos.nom: the tenant in the striped pyjamas
persos.desc: young tenant in his 30s, striped pyjamas, slippers, toothbrush in hand
persos.pose: leaning on his door frame, relaxed and smiling

dialogue: Trois mois sans payer le loyer !
Tonton, c'est toi-même qui as dit : fais comme chez toi !
jeu: The landlord shouts and waves his receipt book. The tenant answers casually, spreading his arms.

lieu: colorful pagne fabric market alley in Adjame, Abidjan, stacks of wax prints, hanging cloth, crowd passing behind

persos.nom: the young woman with the big sunglasses
persos.desc: stylish young woman in her 20s, big sunglasses on her head, orange crop top, long braids
persos.pose: holding a wax fabric, pretending not to care

persos.nom: the fabric seller in the cap
persos.desc: fabric seller in his 40s, flat cap, white kaftan, wooden measuring stick in hand
persos.pose: leaning on his stall, confident

dialogue: Ton pagne-là, c'est combien ?
Dix mille.
Je donne mille, je te laisse le merci.
jeu: The woman asks casually. The seller announces his price proudly. She answers sweetly and the seller's jaw drops.

lieu: roadside garba stall at night in Abidjan, small wooden bench, plastic plates of attieke with fried fish, starry night sky, one weak bulb

persos.nom: the girl in the evening dress
persos.desc: glamorous young woman in her 20s, shiny red evening dress, high heels, clutch bag, long wig
persos.pose: standing in shock, looking at the wooden bench

persos.nom: the boyfriend in the borrowed suit
persos.desc: skinny young man in his 20s, oversized black suit, bow tie, proud smile
persos.pose: pointing proudly up at the starry sky

persos.nom: the garba seller
persos.desc: garba seller in her 40s, headscarf, apron, serving plates
persos.pose: serving two plates, amused

dialogue: Bébé, tu as dit restaurant cinq étoiles !
Lève la tête. Compte les étoiles.
jeu: The girl complains, pointing at the street stall. The boyfriend proudly points at the starry sky and counts the stars with his finger.

lieu: small family kitchen in Abobo, Abidjan, charcoal stove, empty cooking pot, enamel plates on a shelf, evening

persos.nom: the little girl with the empty plate
persos.desc: little girl around 7, short twists, pink t-shirt, holding an empty enamel plate
persos.pose: looking up hopefully

persos.nom: the mother stirring the pot
persos.desc: tired mother in her 30s, yellow headwrap, old green dress, wooden spoon
persos.pose: stirring an empty pot, avoiding eye contact

dialogue: Maman, on mange quoi ce soir ?
Comme hier.
Mais hier on n'a rien mangé !
Tu vois, tu connais déjà.
jeu: The girl asks with hope. The mother keeps stirring and answers flatly. The girl gasps and the mother shrugs.

lieu: neighborhood pharmacy in Cocody, Abidjan, green cross sign, shelves full of medicine boxes, glass counter

persos.nom: the coughing man in the red tracksuit
persos.desc: man in his 30s, red tracksuit, scarf around his neck, holding a small syrup bottle
persos.pose: coughing into his fist

persos.nom: the pharmacist in the white blouse
persos.desc: pharmacist in his 50s, bald head, thin mustache, white blouse, calculator in hand
persos.pose: typing on his calculator with a sly smile

dialogue: Docteur, ce sirop a des effets secondaires ?
Oui. Quand tu vois le prix, tu tousses plus fort.
jeu: The man asks between coughs. The pharmacist shows him the calculator and the man coughs violently in shock.

lieu: inside an old shared woro-woro taxi on a sunny Abidjan boulevard, dashboard with stickers, one rear door rattling open

persos.nom: the passenger holding the door
persos.desc: young woman in her 20s, green office suit, handbag, holding the rattling car door
persos.pose: clinging to the door, terrified

persos.nom: the taxi driver with the toothpick
persos.desc: cheerful taxi driver in his 50s, white cap, toothpick in his mouth, sunglasses
persos.pose: driving with one hand, relaxed

dialogue: Chauffeur, ta portière ne ferme pas !
Tiens-la bien, ma fille. C'est la climatisation.
jeu: The passenger struggles with the door in the wind. The driver answers proudly, enjoying the breeze.

lieu: street barbershop in Treichville, Abidjan, big mirror, hand-painted haircut posters, plastic chair, clippers on a shelf

persos.nom: the client in the barber cape
persos.desc: young man in his 20s under a striped barber cape, with a completely bald shiny head
persos.pose: looking at himself in a hand mirror, horrified

persos.nom: the barber with the clippers
persos.desc: proud barber in his 30s, blue overalls, earring, clippers in hand
persos.pose: admiring his work, satisfied

dialogue: Je t'ai dit : un peu sur les côtés !
Oui, j'ai enlevé les côtés… et le milieu.
jeu: The client stares at his bald head and shouts. The barber blows on his clippers proudly.

lieu: veranda of a family house in Bingerville near Abidjan, wooden bench, chickens walking around, a smartphone on a stool

persos.nom: the old grandfather with the cane
persos.desc: old grandfather in his 80s, white beard, brown kaftan, walking cane, kufi hat
persos.pose: leaning curiously toward the smartphone

persos.nom: the grandson with the earphones
persos.desc: grandson around 16, earphones around his neck, black t-shirt, smartphone in hand
persos.pose: explaining patiently

persos.nom: the father in the work overalls
persos.desc: tired father in his 40s, dusty work overalls, empty pockets turned out
persos.pose: walking past in the background, frowning

dialogue: Mon petit, c'est quoi le wifi ?
Internet sans fil, papi.
Ah ! Comme ton père : salaire sans argent.
jeu: The grandfather asks with curiosity. The grandson explains. The grandfather nods and points at the father walking by.

lieu: modern bank office in the Plateau business district of Abidjan, glass walls, marble counter, skyscrapers through the window

persos.nom: the banker in the grey suit
persos.desc: serious banker in his 40s, grey suit, red tie, thin glasses
persos.pose: looking over his glasses, skeptical

persos.nom: the man in the flower shirt
persos.desc: cheerful man in his 30s, colorful flower shirt, fake gold chain, big smile
persos.pose: leaning on the desk with confidence

dialogue: Vous avez une garantie pour le prêt ?
Oui ! Je vous garantis que je vais revenir.
jeu: The banker asks with a cold voice. The man answers with a huge confident smile and a thumbs-up.

lieu: living room of a Cocody apartment, Abidjan, comfortable sofa, TV showing a football match, low table with drinks, evening

persos.nom: the wife with her hand out
persos.desc: wife in her 30s, red-and-black wax dress, gold earrings
persos.pose: standing over the sofa, palm open, suspicious

persos.nom: the husband hiding his phone
persos.desc: husband in his 30s, orange football jersey, hiding his phone behind his back
persos.pose: sinking into the sofa, nervous smile

dialogue: Chéri, donne-moi ton téléphone.
Il est en mode avion.
Parfait. Qu'il décolle vers ma main !
jeu: The wife holds out her hand. The husband hesitates. She snaps her fingers and points at her palm.

lieu: crowded football stadium stands in Abidjan under the sun, fans in orange, white and green with flags and horns

persos.nom: the employee with the painted face
persos.desc: man in his 30s, face painted orange-white-green, football scarf, phone on his ear
persos.pose: pretending to cough weakly on the phone

persos.nom: the boss on the phone
persos.desc: angry boss in his 50s in an office shirt and tie, shown in a small round video-call bubble in the corner
persos.pose: frowning, phone on his ear

persos.nom: the cheering fan
persos.desc: big cheering fan in his 20s, orange wig, plastic horn
persos.pose: jumping and screaming

dialogue: Tu es malade, c'est ça ?
Oui patron… très malade… BUUUT !
jeu: The boss asks on the phone. The man coughs weakly, then the crowd erupts and he jumps up screaming goal.

lieu: small mobile money kiosk on a street corner in Abobo, Abidjan, yellow umbrella, phone credit posters, plastic stool

persos.nom: the young agent in the yellow cap
persos.desc: young female agent in her 20s, yellow cap, notebook and two phones in front of her
persos.pose: ready to type, waiting

persos.nom: the old man with the cash
persos.desc: old man in his 70s, white boubou, red fez hat, holding banknotes
persos.pose: handing the money proudly

dialogue: Envoie cinq mille à ma femme au village.
Son numéro ?
Pas besoin. Elle va reconnaître son argent.
jeu: The old man hands over the money proudly. The agent asks for the number. He answers with total confidence and she freezes.

lieu: beach at Grand-Bassam near Abidjan, colorful wooden fishing pirogues on the sand, palm trees, sunset

persos.nom: the fisherman with the big net
persos.desc: muscular fisherman in his 40s, yellow raincoat, bare feet, carrying a big net full of fish
persos.pose: proudly showing his catch

persos.nom: the shivering fisherman
persos.desc: skinny fisherman in his 30s, soaking wet, blue shorts, wrapped in a towel, red nose
persos.pose: shivering, holding an empty bucket

dialogue: Mon frère, tu as attrapé quoi aujourd'hui ?
Un rhume.
jeu: The proud fisherman shows off his net. The wet fisherman sneezes loudly and shows his empty bucket.

lieu: festive wedding courtyard in Cocody, Abidjan, decorated white tent, rows of plastic chairs, gift table full of wrapped boxes

persos.nom: the bride's aunt with the notebook
persos.desc: imposing aunt in her 50s, shiny gold boubou and huge headwrap, notebook and pen
persos.pose: blocking the entrance, pen ready

persos.nom: the guest in the shiny purple suit
persos.desc: slim guest in his 30s, shiny purple suit, empty hands, big smile
persos.pose: spreading his empty arms, smiling

dialogue: Mon fils, tu as apporté quel cadeau ?
Ma présence, Tantie. Le transport est cher !
jeu: The aunt asks, pen ready. The guest spreads his empty arms with a big smile and walks in.

lieu: busy hair salon in Yopougon, Abidjan, mirrors, wigs on mannequin heads, hairstyle posters, hair dryer chairs

persos.nom: the client with the phone
persos.desc: young woman in her 20s, short natural hair, denim jacket, showing a glamorous photo on her phone
persos.pose: holding the phone up, excited

persos.nom: the hairdresser with the comb
persos.desc: experienced hairdresser in her 40s, red headscarf, comb in her hair, hands on hips
persos.pose: squinting at the phone, unimpressed

dialogue: Fais-moi les tresses comme sur la photo !
Ma sœur, la photo-là, c'est perruque plus filtre.
jeu: The client shows the photo excitedly. The hairdresser zooms on the phone and shakes her head.

lieu: small bedroom in Abobo, Abidjan, early morning, sunlight through curtains, a rooster on the windowsill, messy bed

persos.nom: the mother with the broom
persos.desc: energetic mother in her 40s, orange wax dress, headwrap, holding a straw broom
persos.pose: opening the curtains with force

persos.nom: the lazy son under the blanket
persos.desc: lazy son around 18, only his head out from under a colorful blanket, sleepy eyes
persos.pose: half asleep, one eye open

dialogue: Debout ! Même les poules sont réveillées !
Maman, les poules dorment à dix-huit heures !
jeu: The mother opens the curtains and shouts. The son pulls the blanket over his head and answers.
